game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Dragon Hoard Cave Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before rock golems overload Dragon Hoard Cave.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before rock golems overload Dragon Hoard Cave. Each round, rock golems strike the crystal door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave: keep the loop_safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: loop_safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Infinite Loop Trap' (Week 4 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while loop_safety > 0.
